source: Exordium/TheCity/TheBeyond/TheEnding initializeEventList + initializeShrineList; AbstractDungeon.initializeSpecialOneTimeEventList; eligibility from AbstractDungeon.getEvent/getShrine

selection.note: AbstractDungeon.generateEvent: with 25% chance (shrineChance) draw from shrineList + specialOneTimeEventList (getShrine), otherwise from eventList (getEvent); getEvent falls back to getShrine when no eventList entry is eligible. A drawn event is removed from its list for the rest of the act (specialOneTimeEventList is shared by the whole run).

notes.Colosseum: Only in the second half of the act map (current row > map rows / 2).

notes.The Moai Head: Only when the player has Golden Idol or is at or below 50% HP.

notes.Fountain of Cleansing: Only when the player has a removable curse (isCursed).
notes.N'loth: Act 2 only (the code checks TheCity twice), and at least 2 relics.
notes.NoteForYourself: Added to the list only outside Daily runs and below Ascension 15, and only at Ascension 0 or below the character's highest unlocked Ascension.
notes.SecretPortal: Act 3 only, and run playtime >= 800 seconds.

notInPools.Spire Heart: Act 4 Heart room text, not a ? room event.
notInPools.Thinking with Puddles: Not added to any event list.
